Business Associates 101: Everything you need to know about Business Associates and HIPAA Compliance Programs.

Relationships with business associates can be confusing. During this webinar you'll receive training on:

  • just who your Business Associates are;
  • what 4 factors must be considered after every security incident;
  • who is required to take reasonable steps to cure a breach or end the violation; and
